message.subject: Partnership idea for Ricoh's training programs
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I saw that Ricoh offers hands-on training programs for sign and graphics professionals—really smart way to add value beyond the equipment sale.

We work with DuPont Tedlar protective films, and I'm wondering if there's an opportunity to integrate overlaminate education into your existing training curriculum. A lot of your customers printing vehicle wraps and outdoor signage are dealing with UV damage and graffiti issues that affect their ROI on Ricoh equipment.

Would you be open to a brief call to explore what a partnership might look like? Could be as simple as adding a module to your current programs.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Ricoh already provides Sign & Graphics Professional Services including hands-on training programs
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: UV protection and graffiti resistance that solves post-sale customer pain points affecting Ricoh equipment ROI
